ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" != "main" ]; then exit 0; fi; BASE="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}"; git cat-file -e "$BASE" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$BASE" HEAD -- docs/ package.json bun.lock package-lock.json vercel.json
buildCommand: cd docs && npm ci && npm run build
